notes.title: New Patch for December 12
notes.content:
Just patching out a few more bugs that have come up and adjusting the game.


Fixed issue in Episode 4 that prevented Nella from being added to photo galleries
Because it isn't possible to get second place, the prize money for first place has been adjusted from $5000 to $7500 (previously the prize for second place was $2500). The Achievement Runner Up has been changed to "Good Loser" and now triggers for placing in the bottom 2 of the tournament.
Added a new option under Preferences to clear all saves and persistent data (aside from Steam Achievements). This can't be undone, so use with caution!

notes.title: Patch Notes December 10, 2024
notes.content:
Pushed out a new update of Super Grapple Day today to address some issues.

*One of the most common issues has been with the economy. To rebalance this, we doubled the reward amount for winning a fight. If this doesn't work or if you've been soft-locked, enter the cheat code TRUST FUND on the Cheats menu to get enough money to buy everything.
*Fixed issue with sprites appearing in wrong place in scenes right before a fight
*Fixed issue with Nella's bounty not paying out correctly

The update looks bigger than it is because we had to run an update on the engine we're using (to fix an issue with the Android version). It's possible this might improve performance for people playing on Steam as well, but most people should see no difference, aside from the issues noted above.

notes.title: November 13 Bug-fixing Patch
notes.content:
Added cheat code menu

Fixed bug that was impacting payout of money after wins. For anyone who won a match and wasn't paid, playing that same match again should result in a payout. Alternatively, if you don't want to do that, just input the code "TRUST FUND" on the cheat page, and then money shouldn't be an issue. :-)
